subject: Marketplace onboarding: evidence & procurement checklist
messages:
From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acmehealth.com>
To: mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace onboarding: initial evidence request

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking the meeting yesterday — Acme Health is moving forward with evaluating Redwood for our tenant-facing inference workloads. Procurement asked me to consolidate the items they need for marketplace listing and internal approval. Can you please provide the following by end of week?

- SOC 2 Type II report (latest period) and evidence index
- Signed DPA or draft that we can share with our legal team
- Tenant isolation / multi-tenant architecture diagram and brief on data residency controls
- Billing and invoicing flow for marketplace purchases (how invoices are generated, billing contact, settlement cadence)
- Support SLA options and escalation path (on-call, enterprise SLAs)
- Any marketplace-specific packaging requirements (AWS/Azure/GCP) or partner IDs we should reference

If you have a short checklist or a single zip for procurement, that would be ideal. Also please confirm an estimated timeline — our procurement deadline is 12/02.

Appreciate it,

Lisa Chen
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Health

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding: initial evidence request

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Karthik (tech partnerships), Lauren (commercial/procurement), and Olga (security) to compile.

We can deliver an evidence bundle and a one-page index that maps each procurement ask to a document/link. Proposed plan:

1) By Fri 11/27: initial evidence index + SOC2 summary + network diagram (PDF/PNG)
2) By Mon 11/30: full zip with signed DPA (or redline-ready DocuSign link), billing flow diagram, SLA options, marketplace partner IDs and packaging notes
3) If Acme needs a live Q&A, we can schedule a 30-minute procurement call the week of 11/30.

Attachments I’ll prepare: "redwood_marketplace_evidence_index.xlsx" (index & mapping), "SOC2_Type2_Redwood-Inference-2026.pdf" (summary + auditor statement), and network/billing diagrams.

Quick ask for you: can you confirm the procurement contact for invoice/PO setup and whether Acme will purchase via AWS Marketplace (metering), Azure Marketplace, or direct seat license? That determines the billing diagram we send.

Mina Haddad
Head of GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference

[On Wed, 25 Nov 2026 at 09:12, Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acmehealth.com> wrote:]
> Thanks Mina — the 12/02 deadline is important for our internal board review.
> 
> Lisa

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: mina_haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding: initial evidence request

Mina — quick status and questions as I start assembling the technical bits.

Status: I have the network diagram (v3) and a short write-up on tenant isolation patterns (namespace + VPC-per-tenant options + optional customer VPC peering). Olga, can you confirm if the SOC2 PDF we host has an auditors' letter we can include (redacted)? If so, I'll reference the exact page numbers in the index.

Questions:
- Billing: do we provide an AWS Metering (Marketplace) flow + direct invoice flow? I think we support both but need to confirm which product SKU Acme expects.
- DPA: do we have a templated DPA for marketplace customers or do we only do direct DPAs? Lauren — do you have the Acme Legal contact?

I'll draft the evidence_index workbook and include doc locations (Drive links). Planning to assemble initial bundle by EOD Friday.

Karthik
Sr Partner Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acmehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, olga_petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Marketplace Ops AWS <marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding: initial evidence request — evidence bundle and next steps

Hi Lisa / Acme Procurement,

Attached is the consolidated evidence bundle and a short onboarding runbook for marketplace listing: "evidence_bundle_20261130.zip". For quick navigation we included a one-tab index (redwood_marketplace_evidence_index.xlsx) that maps each procurement item to a file or link. Highlights:

- SOC2 Type II: attached PDF (redacted). Auditor letter included (see page 3).
- DPA: attached signed DPA draft (DPA_Redwood-AcmeHealth-signed.pdf). If Acme requires modifications, we added a DocuSign review link for legal (see links).
- Tenant isolation & residency: network_arch_diagram-v3.png + short note describing optional VPC peering and customer-managed KMS.
- Billing: billing_flow_sequence.drawio.png — covers AWS Marketplace metering flow and direct invoicing / seat licensing. Lauren has summarized commercial options in the index.
- SLAs & Escalation: included SLA tiers (Standard / Enterprise) and on-call escalation roster.

We’ve also included marketplace packaging notes for AWS/Azure/GCP and the partner IDs you’ll need for catalog registration.

Next steps we propose:
1) Please confirm whether Acme wants marketplace metering (AWS/GCP) or direct purchasing. That will determine invoice generation and the integration steps with your AP system.
2) If you want a short procurement Q&A, I’m available 11/30 3:00–4:00pm PT for a 30-min call. Karthik and Olga will join to cover technical/security items.
3) If legal needs to redline the DPA, share comments via the DocuSign link; we’ll triage within 48 hours.

Attachments (included in zip): redwood_marketplace_evidence_index.xlsx, SOC2_Type2_Redwood-Inference-2026.pdf, DPA_Redwood-AcmeHealth-signed.pdf, network_arch_diagram-v3.png, billing_flow_sequence.drawio.png

Thanks — looking forward to moving this across the finish line.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Head of GTM Partnerships
Redwood Inference

[Attachment stub: evidence_bundle_20261130.zip (contains index + docs listed above)]

From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@acmehealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marketplace Ops AWS <marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding: initial evidence request — evidence bundle and next steps

Hi Mina — received the bundle, thank you. Procurement confirms the files look complete at a first pass. A couple quick clarifications before our board review tomorrow:

1) Billing — we will purchase via AWS Marketplace (metering) for the initial pilot. Can you confirm whether Redwood supports consolidated invoicing for multiple accounts under a single payer? If not, we need to know how invoices appear and what fields our AP team should match on (PO, customer account ID).

2) Tenant isolation — in the network diagram the option referencing customer-managed KMS is attractive. Can you confirm whether you can provide a short statement that keys are never exported from a customer-managed key store and how KMS is integrated with your inference runtime? That will be passed to our security reviewers.

Procurement has created an internal ticket: ACME-PROC-20261130-18. If you can respond to the two items above and share any additional marketplace partner IDs we should include on the PO, we’ll proceed to internal sign-off.

Lisa Chen
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Health
